- **FLUX.3 fills the area you marked.** In Paint area, FLUX.3 could place a new subject only partly
  inside an area (the rest of it was cut off by the area's edge), leaving the area half empty. Its
  instruction now says to use the whole marked area. It also gets the area in FLUX.3's own box
  format, the one Layout uses for new images, so it knows exactly where the area is. Fibo 2.0 gets
  the "whole area" wording too.
